lines.t: Look at the earth before man put his fingerprints all over it.
Mountains don’t need a logo.
The ocean don’t need a filter.
The stars don’t need your approval.
Creation speaks—and modern man stays scrolling.
But the Creator is not silent.
YahuShua is coming to take His world back.
Sun crack gold on the ridge at dawn,
Mist in the valley, wild deer on the lawn,
Thunder talk deep while the old trees yawn,
Every leaf got a signature: YaHuWaH drawn.
Rivers run clean through the ribs of the land,
Moon pull tides with an unseen hand,
Eagles cut skies where the high winds stand,
Creation got order—man don’t understand.
Snow on the mountain, fire in the core,
Seeds break soil, then the forests roar,
Bees in the bloom, whales in the shore,
Every living breath got a reason for.
Sky full of galaxies, black velvet frame,
Planets in orbit, none missing their lane,
But man took beauty, then branded his name,
Built a glass prison and called it “gain.”
The earth keeps preaching—
Man keeps reaching
For a throne he was never meant to own.
He built his kingdom
Out of dead things,
Then wonders why his spirit feels alone.
Eden versus the machine!
Living water versus poison in the stream!
YahuShua coming—tear the false crown clean!
King of the earth, King of the seen and unseen!
Eden versus the machine!
Man made a system, but it cannot redeem!
Burn every idol, let the true King reign—
New world rising through the old world’s pain!
Man made cities where the night never sleeps,
Screens in the face while the soul starves deep,
Algorithms feed what the wounded keep,
Selling fake love to the lost like sheep.
Plastic halos, digital graves,
Bodies for sale, everybody enslaved,
Old men profit while the children get played,
Then they call it freedom when the family caves.
Steel skyline shining like an idol shrine,
Dead-eyed crowds in a checkout line,
Chemical food and a medicated mind,
Everybody rich online, bankrupt inside.
Man engineered lust, packaged the rage,
Turned rebellion into a product page,
Made the prison look clean with a high-tech cage—
But the King gonna shut down the whole dark stage.
You can’t code a conscience.
You can’t buy a soul.
You can’t build a kingdom
When the foundation got no hole.
You can stack your money,
You can weaponize fear—
But when YahuShua speaks,
Every proud voice disappears.
Eden versus the machine!
Living water versus poison in the stream!
YahuShua coming—tear the false crown clean!
King of the earth, King of the seen and unseen!
Eden versus the machine!
Man made a system, but it cannot redeem!
Burn every idol, let the true King reign—
New world rising through the old world’s pain!
Man calls his inventions progress
while the heart becomes colder.
He calls darkness enlightenment
because he fears the Light.
But the One who formed every atom,
every ocean trench,
every living creature,
every human breath—
He is coming.
And the counterfeit cannot survive the presence of the King.
Hear the hooves in the clouds, hear the heavens divide,
No politician, no weapon, no empire can hide,
Every tower that mocked Him gets stripped of its pride,
Every king of the flesh gets exposed when He rides.
Sword from His mouth, truth cut sharp,
Light hit hard like a sun through dark,
He don’t need man’s bombs to dismantle the parts—
One word from the King shakes the earth to its heart.
But His judgment ain’t random, His fire makes room,
For the garden to rise where rebellion made tombs,
For the nations to heal, for the righteous to bloom,
For the Lamb to reign under an everlasting moon.
No more market of souls, no more child fed to greed,
No more lie dressed up as a human need,
No more beast systems planting death as seed—
YahuShua rules, and the earth gets freed.
Eden versus the machine!
The Lion is coming, He’s breaking the screen!
YahuShua reigns, let the hard heart scream—
No artificial god can stand in His beam!
Eden versus the machine!
His river runs life, His kingdom stays clean!
New earth, new song, righteous King supreme—
The whole creation bows to YahuShua, the King!
The creation was never yours to corrupt.
The earth belongs to YaHuWaH.
Your systems pass.
Your idols fall.
YahuShua remains.
And His kingdom has no end.
